I’ve been coming here for 2 years. The first time I brung my dog here great cut and colors. The second time sloppy. I said next time I go I will be more detailed on what I want for my dog. However, this time his Mohawk was gone. I gave another chance and just notice the front desk clerks and owner attitude has gotten worse over time. I kind of waited around one day to see maybe they don’t like me let’s see how they talk to the next guest so I waited around. Sure enough it’s the same nasty attitude. I came back to pick my pets up I now have 2 dogs. The entire place smells like bleach and dogs are barking like crazy due to the fumes.while waiting one of the groomers told a dog to shut up n I lean to the side to see what was going on shortly after someone got up n slammed the door so hard so I couldn’t see. My dogs finally come from the back sneezing, running eyes, and just completely irritated from the bleach. It was so bad that my eyes was burning no exaggeration. I believe this place has bad employees because the owner lady can be very rude and always has a nasty attitude. Unhappy manger equals unhappy employees. I will no longer be returning due to the constant issue I have at this place.

Friendly staff.

Longtime customer

Brought my 5lb dog in for a nail trim. Upon taking her to the back, the lady dragged her by the leash forcefully. I should’ve walked out then as I had a bad feeling. She returned my dog to me bleeding around her upper leg. I can understand cutting the nails too far and accidentally causing her to bleed. But why is her upper leg bleeding? Why was this not communicated to me? At the very least explain what happened to the owner, don’t just return a bleeding dog to them without saying anything 😅😅. I didn’t notice she was bleeding until I got in my car. Just decided I will never be coming back here. Very unprofessional, untrained, and terrible staff.

I have a dog who tends to be a little "extra."  The staff at Doggone Rite have a great rapport with him. He always gets all of the attention that he needs (but never wants) and we are always happy. The owner, her daughter and all of the groomers are VERY nice and I'm always at ease, leaving my baby with them.
Phenomenal work and great job. They are polite, informative and respectful.

It saddens me to write this review and change a previous good review.  This place use to be amazing! I have been coming to them for 15 years since 2010 since they were on 79th near Pulaski with three different dogs and have referred countless friends,  family,  and even strangers to them. However this last visit will be my last visit. I have primarily dealt with the husband who has always been kind and welcoming. The wife is the total opposite not friendly at all . However,  I've disregarded this for years due to the good quality work they have done. Todat that changed I picked up my sister's dog and the girl at the front desk had a disgusting attitude so much so that I will never come here again. Very snarky clearly hates her job. She was not customer friendly or dog friendly. They charged a $120 with $55 being a detangaling fee on a 6 pound dog. They cut him down to skin and bones so I'm confused about what they detangled . The hair on his head was uneven his face was blotchy. Over all they did not do a good job. Her response "put your hands in his face more becase he kept trying to bite the clippers"! Insert stale face... he's 3 months it's his first grooming of course he's scared! I don't feel like writing a dissertation but my sister also mentioned she was very rude to her which makes me feel embarrassed because I referred her. I won't be bringing my dog here anymore nor referring anyone. The culture, and face of the business has taken a turn for the worst  the prices have increased which is fine but I'm not gonna pay someone to be rude to me. Square one finding a new groomer!!!

Absolutely the only place we take Bella to get groomed. We’ve been taking her here for over a decade at this point and for good reason. They always get our baby doggone rite and are quick to do it! She’s safe here and always comes out cute. There have been times when I’ve picked her up and wanted her cut lower in some places and they always oblige. I’d recommend always getting the flea bath even if you know your dog doesn’t have fleas. It’s $5 extra but always worth it. We pay $70 after everything, but it’s always the best money we spend any time we take her.

My poor dog. I was hesitant to bring my dog here but I thought hey why not the reviews aren’t that bad . Once I brought my dog here  I got him back three to four hours later but I gave them the benefit of the doubt,thinking well maybe they’re busy. But it made me wonder was my dog getting at-least water the time he was there probably not ? Okay I took my dog there a second time this time on the way there he was trembling. Now my dog isn’t even scared to go to the vet and he’s not even scared to get his shots so I’m questioning why is my dog scared to go the groomers . So whatever I take him and I get him back . And this last and final time I took him there again he was trembling and he was there for 4 hours to possibly even 5 hours so I’m thinking he’s probably starving and thirsty. I take him home he’s dragging his butt on the floor he looks like he’s in pain and I seen that they cut his butt area I take him to the vet it cost me $200 dollars . I haven’t took him there since and I started grooming him and he gives me no problem at all and gets happy when I cut his fur clip his nails etc so  it really makes me wonder what we’re they doing to my dog that cost me $200 at the vet and why was he so scared why was he there for hours in end ?

Please believe the reviews, when I say some places aren’t deserving of your hard working money this is the place. From the time you walk in you are met with rudeness from the owner she barely wants to say good morning back! She is very aggressive with your pets. Someone said in the reviews that they dog gets scared when they see this place. Same experience, I had with my dog. They will get very defensive and ignorant just off you asking them questions. She doesn’t appreciate the business that you bring to them, they literally make you stand outside,,where else do they do that. Another customer told me they had to take the police up there before because her & the owner got into it! People need to realize its a privilege to spend your money with them.
